points.note: Setpoint Absolute Flow in unit selected Shows the setpoint in unit selected in MV[121]

points.name: SpRel
points.note: Relative Setpoint in % Setpoint for actuator if controlled via bus Position Control Setpoint 0...100% refers to relative position 0...100% Flow Control Setpoint 0...33% refers to range Vmax1...0 l/h i.e. Setpoint 0% = Vmax1 / Setpoint 33% =

points.name: Vnom UnitSel _
points.note: Nominal Flow in unit selected Vnom in unit selected in MV[121]

points.name: SummaryStatus
points.note: _ Summary Status Summary of all Status (MI[103] - MI[106])

points.name: ActSequence
points.note: Active Sequence

points.name: StatusSensor
points.note: Status Sensor

points.name: StatusFlow
points.note: Status Flow Flow not reached: Setpoint connnot be reached within 3 min while in flow control Flow in closed position: Flow is measured but postion of valve is closed (Dead band)

points.name: StatusMedia
points.note: Status Media Airbubbles: Airbubbles in the hydronic system. As long as there are airbubbles in the system, position control mode is active, regardless off control mode setting (ControlMode MV[100]).

points.name: StatusActuator
points.note: Status Actuator Actuator cannot move: Mechanical overload e.g. blocked actuator, etc. Gear disengaged: Button is pressed

points.name: Override
points.note: Override Control Override the setpoint (SpRel AO[1] or analog signal) with defined values

points.name: ControlMode
points.note: Control Mode PosCtrl: Position Control FlowCtrl: Flow Control

points.name: UnitSelFlow
points.note: Unit Selection Flow The selected unit is valid for AI[19], AI[109] and AI[119]

points.name: SpSource
points.note: Setpoint Source If Analog(1) then actuator is controlled by analog signal 0...10 V on wire 3. If Bus(2) then setpoint via bus SpRel AO[1]
